_comment: The judge model's limits, stated once; every size and endpoint tied to the judge is read from here (judge_profile.py for Python, src/judge-profile.ts for Node, which apply the same rules). There is one judge, so nothing selects among profiles. window_tokens is the judge's hard input ceiling for the state plus the longest question; max_questions_per_call is how many questions one call may carry; input_usd_per_mtok is its published input price per million tokens; max_parts is how many judge calls one direct check may need before it is refused; confidence_line is the confidence under which a human reads the source; file_ceiling_bytes is the largest file that connects whole (a larger file is held, never cut into sections); gate_window_tokens is the evidence window the Stop gate sends. All sizes are counted in judge tokens, bytes/2.

typesafe-jev._source: window: the measured hard input ceiling; questions: the per-call cap every batcher plans under; price: docs.typesafe.ai, checked 2026-09-16
